crs.status: from article source-data table; confirm against full processing outputs before GIS overlay use

scenePlacement.note: Object points are centered and lifted with the same transform as the sampled TLS preview.

processing.method: Standalone inverse-distance weighted outer surface from sparse object points, trimmed inside the actual TLS island footprint.

tlsTrimBoundary.method: Largest boundary loop from TLS mesh boundary edges

processing.triangleWinding: counter-clockwise from +Z / upward-facing for app FrontSide rendering
processing.fillPolicy: Outer surface only. Coarse cells inside the actual TLS island footprint are removed. Exterior and TLS-cutout boundary loops are spline-smoothed in scene space. No seam, no island knit, no combined mesh, and no rectangular TLS cutout.
